Authored C callbacks returning two signed 64-bit fields, plus scalar and void controls.
Original build:
cc -O2 -g -fwrapv -fno-pie -no-pie -o /tmp/kuna-joined-callback-return/callback /tmp/kuna-joined-callback-return/callback.c
The original callback.c is byte-identical to joined_callback_return.c.
Equivalent rebuild from this directory:
cc -O2 -g -fwrapv -fno-pie -no-pie -o joined_callback_return_x86_64 joined_callback_return.c

cc (Ubuntu 11.4.0-1ubuntu1~22.04.3) 11.4.0
